evidence.detail: rs/d/t loads the floor-overlay table from exact flo2.dat / osrs_flo2.dat paths selected by the existing REGULAR/OLDSCHOOL/OSRS floor-definition mode, allocates one definition per decoded entry, and emits surviving [OverlayFloor] diagnostics.

Its decoders populate primary/secondary RGB values, texture ids, render/occlusion flags and derived hue/saturation/lightness state; unrecognized attributes report the exact surviving text 'Error unrecognised overlay code'.
R53 ObjectManager indexes rs/d/t.b from terrain overlay ids and consumes its texture, color, HSL and visibility fields while constructing scene tile paint/model geometry.

proposals.note: FloorOverlayDefinition is the conservative semantic name for the exact flo2-backed floor-overlay definition; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/d/z loads exact varp.dat bytes from StreamLoader, decodes a counted definition table, and reports the surviving diagnostic 'varptype load mismatch' when the stream length is inconsistent.
Its opcode decoder records the integer client-setting type used by the runtime, maintains the classic flagged-varp index list, and marks a boolean property for opcodes 8/11.
R28 VarbitDefinition directly indexes rs/d/z.a using each varbit's referenced base variable and marks that VarpDefinition when the varbit carries the corresponding flag.
Client.B(varpId) reads rs/d/z.a[varpId].b together with the current varp value and dispatches the resulting setting behavior, fixing this class as varp metadata rather than a generic integer config.

proposals.note: VarpDefinition is the conservative semantic name for this exact varp.dat client-variable parameter definition; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
